NEWS RELEASE | SEPTEMBER 1, 2026 | LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM
PULSAR LAUNCHES NEW CORPORATE WEBSITE

Pulsar Helium Inc. (AIM: PLSR, TSXV: PLSR, OTCQB: PSRHF) ("Pulsar" or the "Company"), a primary helium company, is pleased to announce the launch of its new website, providing a comprehensive digital hub for information on helium, the Company's project portfolio and the investment opportunity.

The new website has been designed to provide a central destination for investors, researchers, industry participants and the wider public to explore Pulsar's activities and access educational and informational resources relating to helium.
The website brings together the Company's corporate and investor information with a range of new content and features, including:

​³He Hub: A dedicated information center covering the properties, applications and potential of helium-3 (³He), with details of Pulsar's ³He discovery at its Topaz Project, the Company's ³He Research Initiative, and a curated collection of external sources and research.

Project Portfolio: Detailed information on Pulsar's portfolio of primary helium exploration projects, including the flagship Topaz Project in Minnesota and the Tunu Project in Greenland, alongside the Company's newer Falcon and Torino projects in the USA.

Investor Hub: A comprehensive suite of investor resources, including Company news, financial statements, stock information, corporate presentations, governance, ESG, AGM materials and AIM Rule 26 information.
Pulsar Community: Dedicated content showcasing the Company's community engagement initiatives.

The launch forms part of Pulsar's ongoing efforts to improve the accessibility of information, engage and educate new demographics about helium criticality and communicate the Company's activities and the wider importance of primary helium to a broader audience.
Thomas Abraham-James, CEO of Pulsar, commented:

"We are very pleased to launch our new website, which we have designed to be much more than a traditional corporate website. It is intended to be a central hub for all things helium, bringing together information about Pulsar, our project portfolio, the helium market and the science and applications behind this critically important element.

"The new website also reflects the evolution of Pulsar as we advance our portfolio of projects. Alongside our investor resources, we wanted to create a platform through which people can engage with our work, our communities and the wider helium story."
The new website is available at https://pulsarhelium.com
On behalf of Pulsar Helium Inc.
"Thomas Abraham-James"
CEO and Director

About Pulsar Helium Inc.

Pulsar Helium Inc. is a publicly traded company quoted on the AIM market of the London Stock Exchange (United Kingdom) and listed on the TSX Venture Exchange with the ticker PLSR (Canada), as well as on the OTCQB with the ticker PSRHF (United States of America). Pulsar's portfolio consists of its flagship Topaz helium project in Minnesota, the Falcon project in Michigan (both in the USA), and the Tunu helium project in Greenland. Pulsar is the first mover in both locations with primary helium occurrences not associated with the production of hydrocarbons identified at each.
